description: Update the local triage fields of a Dropscan mailing (never touches Dropscan itself): review_status, is_official_mail, deadline_at (ISO) + deadline_note + deadline_kind ('frist'=we must act | 'termin'=something happens), sender_name, subject, ai_summary. Use this after reading a scan to record what it is. Setting review_status='actioned'/'archived' is the ONLY way a mailing leaves the inbox — there is no auto-filing rule, because a missed Frist is unrecoverable.

ai_summary.description: Short summary of the letter's content

deadline_kind.description: frist = we must act, termin = something happens on that date

deadline_note.description: Short note on what the deadline requires

is_official_mail.description: Whether the letter is official mail from an authority (Behoerdenpost)

mailing_id.description: ID of the group mailing to change

review_status.description: Local triage status: new, in_review, actioned or archived; actioned/archived leaves the inbox

name: update_dropscan_mailing
